statement: Implement parse_duration(text) -> int in duration.py exactly as specified in SPEC.md (in the artifacts folder). SPEC.md is the whole specification: behaviour it does not ask for is not required.
success_criterion: parse_duration returns the value SPEC.md requires for every input, raises the errors SPEC.md requires, and the unit tests pass.
oracles: independent checks of each numbered rule in SPEC.md

submission.claim: duration.py implements parse_duration as specified in SPEC.md, with exact arithmetic; all 3 test groups (40 cases) pass.
assertions: components are parsed left to right with a single regular expression; units are case-insensitive
units must be in strictly descending order and appear at most once
the total is computed exactly with fractions.Fraction and must be a whole number of seconds
a bare non-negative integer is seconds; invalid text raises ValueError and a non-str raises TypeError
submission.provenance: Implemented with re and fractions.Fraction (no floating point). Verified with python3 -m unittest test_duration -v.
